text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In preparation for the Fan Fest, Special Week and company are rehearsing their costumed hero play.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, El Condor Pasa distances herself, claiming she can't participate because she's chosen a different path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it was just a lie to shock everyone! She surprises her friends by jumping into practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa has fun practicing for the hero play with all of her friends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The qualities of an entertainer—a focus on fun and amazement—are an important virtue she inherited from her father.
